title: Remove the stale claims merge-driver entry
description:
`jit init` writes a union-merge entry for `.jit/claims.jsonl`, but claim coordination writes its append-only log under the shared `.git/jit/` control plane.

Source: `crates/jit/src/storage/gitattributes.rs:1-8,57-62`; `crates/jit/src/storage/worktree_paths.rs:8-22,93-103`; `crates/jit/src/storage/claim_coordinator.rs:701-724`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A newly initialized git repository has no merge-driver entry for `.jit/claims.jsonl` unless that path becomes a supported persisted file.
- [hard] REQ-02: Any remaining JIT merge-driver entries correspond to files written in their documented storage plane.
- [hard] REQ-03: Focused initialization coverage verifies `.gitattributes` and the real claim-log location.
